req.title: Task title trimmed of whitespace
req.statement: The system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from the title on POST /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should trim leading and trailing whitespace from the task title when creating a task via the POST /tasks/ endpoint. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_post_task_title_trimmed_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title containing leading and trailing whitespace.
expected: The returned task title has no leading or trailing whitespace.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": "  New Task  ",
        "description": "A task with whitespace in title",
        "completed": false
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "New Task"

tests.name: test_post_task_title_trimmed_negative
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty title.
expected: The response contains a validation error for the title field.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": " ",
        "description": "A task with empty title",
        "completed": false
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "value_error.any_str.min_length" in str(response.json())

tests.name: test_post_task_title_trimmed_boundary
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of exactly 100 characters, including leading and trailing whitespace.
expected: The returned task title has no leading or trailing whitespace and is exactly 100 characters long.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

long_title = " " + "a" * 98 + " "
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": long_title,
        "description": "A task with a long title",
        "completed": false
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "a" * 98
